spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (मृग्यति) r. 10th cl. (मृगयते)
To seek, to pursue, to hunt, to chase.

m. (-गः)
1 A deer, an antelope.
2 An animal in general.
3 Research, inquiry, investigation.
4 Asking, soliciting, begging.
5 A kind of elephant, one with white marks on his forehead.
6 The fifth lunar constellation, more usually Mṛgaśiras: see मृगशिरस्.
7 The month in which the moon is full in the constellation

Mṛgaśiras.
8

A particular sacrifice.
9

Musk.
10

Hunting, chase.
11 One of the four classes into which men are divided, in erotic works.
f. (-गी)
1 A description of woman, perhaps the same as the one termed त्रित्रिणी, the corresponding female to the male called मृग.
2 A female deer, a doe.
3 A species of the Madhya metre.
E.
मृग to search, to chase, aff. घञ्.

n. (-रं)
Doe's milk.
E.
मृग for मृगी a female deer, and क्षीर milk.

m. (-कः)
A wild or pole cat.

f. (-का)
A net for confining deer.
E.
मृग a deer, and जालिका a net.

m. (-नः)
A hunter.
E.
मृग a deer, and जीवन living, subsistence.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Search, inquiry, research.
E.
मृग to search for or after, aff. युच् and टाप्.

f. (-तृट्)
Vapour floating over sands or desarts, and appearing at a distance like water.
E.
मृग a deer, तृष् to thirst, aff. क्विप्; deer being deceived by it; also with अङ्, and टाप् aff. मृगतृषा, and with तृष्णा thirst, मृगतृष्णा.

f. (-षा)
Mirage: see the last.

f. (-ष्णा)
Sultry vapour, mirage: see the last.

f. (-का)
Sultry vapour.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-कः)
A dog.
E.
मृग deer, and दंशक who bites.

m. (-द्युत्)
A hunter.
E.
मृग and द्यु to go, क्विप् aff. and तुक् added.

m. (-द्यूः)
A hunter.
E.
मृग, and दिब to play, क्विप् aff., and the semivowel changed.

m. (-कः)
A jackal.
E.
मृग a deer, and धूर्त्तक a cheat; preying upon them only in consequence of his luring them into his reach.

m. (-भिः)
Musk.
E.
मृग a deer, (the musk deer,) and नाभि the navel; the musk being formed in a bag attached to the belly of the animal about the navel.

nf. (-जं-जा)
Musk.
E.
मृग a deer, नाभि the navel, and ज produced.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Possessing or relating to the constellation Mṛgaśīrṣa.
f. (-त्री)
A woman with beautiful eyes, or eyes like a deer.
E.
मृग the asterism, णा to get, तृच् aff., and अप् added, or मृग a deer, and नेत्र the eye.

m. (-तिः)
A lion.
E.
मृग an animal or a deer, and पति lord.

n. (-दं)
A deer's foot.
E.
मृग, and पद for पाद foot.

f. (-का)
The musk deer.
E.
मृग a deer, पाल to nourish, वुन् aff., fem. form.

m. (-प्लुः)
The moon.
E.
मृग a deer, and पिप्ल a mark or spot.

m. (-वः)
A hunter, a deer-killer.
E.
मृग a deer, बध killing, and आजीव who lives by.

f. (-नी)
A net for confining deer.
E.
मृग a deer, and बन्धिनी confinement.

f. (-नी)
Bitter apple or Colocynth.
E.
मृग, and भोजन eating.

m. (-दः)
Musk.
E.
मृग a deer, and मद passion, or fluid that distils from the elephant's temples when in rut, and to which this secretion is considered analogous.

f. (-का)
A female antelope.
E.
मृग, and मातृ mother कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Seeking, pursuing, hunting.
E.
मृग to seek, शानच् aff.

f. (-या)
Chase, hunting.
E.
मृग to search or seek, यत् aff., deriv. irr.

BRAHMĀ.
2

A jackal.
3 A hunter.
E.
मृग a deer, या to go, कु Uṇādi aff., form irr.

m. (-राट्)
A lion.
E.
मृग an animal, and राज् who rules over; also with a final vowel, मृगराज m. (-जः.)

m. (-पुः)
A lion.
E.
मृग an animal, and रिपु the enemy.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Woollen, (cloth, &c.)
E.
मृग an animal, रोम hair, and ज produced, made.

m. (-नः)
The moon.
E.
मृग a deer, लाच्छन symbol, sign.

m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
E.
मृग a deer, and वाहन vehicle.

n. (-व्यं)
1 Chase, hunting.
2 The butt or mark in archery.
E.
मृग a deer, व्यथ to destroy, aff. ड.

n. (-रः)
The fifth lunar mansion, containing three stars, one of which is λ ORIONIS, and figured by an antelope's head, whence its name.
E.
मृग a deer, and शिरस् the head; also मृगशिरा f. (-रा) or मृगशिरस् m. (-राः.)

m. (-र्षः)
The constellation Mṛgaśiras: see the last.
E.
मृग a deer, and शीर्ष the head; also f. (-र्षा.)

f. (-क्षी)
1 Bitter apple, (Cucumis coloquintida.)
2 A woman with eyes like a deer's.
E.
मृग a deer, अक्षि the eye.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 The moon.
2 Air, wind.
E.
मृग a deer, and अङ्क a mark, a symbol, or अकि to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
A deer skin.
E.
मृग, and अजिन a skin.

m. (-वः)
1 A hyena.
2 A hunter.
E.
मृग a deer, and आजीव who lives by or preys upon.

f. (-जा)
Musk.
E.
मृग a deer, अण्ड testicle, and ज produced.

m. (-ट् or -त्)
A tiger.
E.
मृग a deer, अद to eat, aff. क्विन्.

m. (-नः)
1 A hyena.
2 A leopard.
f. (-नी)
Colocynth, (Cucumis coloquintida.)
E.
मृग a deer, and अदन eating.

m. (-कः)
The Cīta or hunting leopard.
E.
मृग a deer, and अन्तक destroyer.

m. (-तिः)
A dog.
E.
मृग a deer, and अराति an enemy.

m. (-रिः)
1 A lion.
2 A tiger.
3 A dog, a hound.
E.
मृग a deer, and अरि an enemy.

m. (-विट्)
A hunter, a deer-killer.
E.
मृग a deer, व्यध to destroy, with आङ् prefix, and क्विप् aff., and the semivowel changed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sought, pursued.
E.
मृग to chase, aff. क्त.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A lion.
E.
मृग an animal, and इन्द्र lord, master

m. (-कः)
A hawk, a falcon.
E.
मृगेन्द्र a lion, and चटक a sparrow.

n. (-खं)
1 The lion's mouth.
2 A species of the Atijagatī metre.
E.
मृगेन्द्र, and मुख mouth.

m. (-रुः)
A white deer.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
To be sought or inquired for.
E.
मृग to search, क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being sought or inquired after.
E.
मृग to search, pass. v., शानच् aff.
